variants.title: Counting crates
variants.premise: He is counting the wine crates on the dock and keeps losing his place.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Any chance of getting a ship out of here?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Tetamo. You've made me lose count again.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Twelve, thirteen... no. Back to one.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Sorry. I only want passage somewhere.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then ask a sailor. I pick grapes.

options.label: Who's in charge of the crates?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The foreman. He's up at the vineyard.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Don't tell him I lost count.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Wine. Last year's, off the north slope.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is it any good?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You won't regret it if you try some.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Never. I'd like to keep it that way.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Water's for the grapes.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Mind the gulls on your way past.

variants.title: Foreman's temper
variants.premise: He is sat on a crate waiting on the dwarves' cart from Mistrock, glad of someone to talk at.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I'm after a boat off this island. Know anyone?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Nilsal. Sit down before somebody sees you standing about.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The foreman, I mean. He's about somewhere.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: So no boat, then.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not from me, iknami. I watch crates, that's all.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: His brother married into the big villa.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Now he's got a temper and no vines.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: They try. Then they come back grumbling.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Something about the capital saying no.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The grapes are in good shape this year.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Shame about everything else.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva. Say nothing about the crate.

variants.title: Shiny back
variants.premise: He is eating his lunch on the wine crates when he notices what the player is wearing.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I need a ship. Can anyone here help me?

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The worker stops chewing and stares at your back.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Tetamo. That's the one from the fighting pit.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: The Colosseum, yes.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then you're not my trouble. You're the harbour's.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The big one at the capital. The Cothon.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: There's a fellow there with a ledger.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: He decides. Not me.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: My cousin described it once. Bragged for weeks.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: He never got one. Go on, the capital.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No. Show it to the ledger fellow, not me.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I've grapes to think about.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva. Try the capital harbour.
